title: Login fails after 3 attempts even with correct password
description: User reports that after exactly 3 failed login attempts, the account gets locked. On the 4th attempt with the CORRECT password, login still fails with ERR_401_UNAUTH. Expected: account should unlock after cooldown per TC-0142.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Go to /login
2. Enter wrong password 3 times
3. Enter correct password on 4th try
4. Observe ERR_401_UNAUTH instead of successful login

title: Account lockout not clearing after correct password entry
description: Similar to earlier reports -- lockout mechanism doesn't release even when the right creds are used. Might be same root cause as BUG-1001, filed separately by support team without cross-checking.
steps_to_reproduce: Same as BUG-1001. See TC-0142 for expected lockout/cooldown behavior.

title: Checkout page times out on slow connections
description:
On 3G/throttled connections, checkout submission hangs for 30s then returns ERR_504_TIMEOUT.

No retry mechanism exists.   Customer lost cart contents.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Throttle network to Slow 3G
2. Add item to cart
3. Proceed to checkout
4. Submit payment form
5. Wait 30s -> ERR_504_TIMEOUT

title: Payment declined shows generic error instead of decline reason
description: When a card is declined by the processor, UI shows "Something went wrong" instead of the actual decline reason (insufficient funds, expired card, etc). Backend receives proper decline codes from processor but frontend swallows them.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Use test card 4000000000000002 (generic decline)
2. Attempt payment
3. Observe generic error message

title: Search returns zero results for queries with hyphens
description: Searching for "wi-fi" returns 0 results even though 40+ products contain "wifi" or "wi-fi" in title. Tokenizer appears to split on hyphen inconsistently between indexing and query time.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Go to search bar
2. Type 'wi-fi'
3. Submit
4. Compare to searching 'wifi' (returns results)

title: Push notifications sent twice for same order update
description: Users report receiving duplicate push notifications for the same order status change (e.g. 'Order Shipped' twice within seconds). Suspect race condition in notification queue worker.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Place an order
2. Trigger status change to 'Shipped' via admin panel
3. Observe 2 identical push notifications on device

title: Admin panel bulk export crashes on >5000 rows
description: Exporting user list to CSV from admin panel throws ERR_500_INTERNAL when row count exceeds ~5000. Works fine under that threshold. Likely a memory issue in the export job, not a timeout (job dies immediately at high volume, not after a delay).
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Log in as admin
2. Go to Users > Export
3. Select 'All users' (>5000 in prod)
4. Click export
5. ERR_500_INTERNAL after ~2s

title: Password reset email delayed by up to 20 minutes
description: Password reset emails sometimes take 15-20 min to arrive instead of near-instant delivery. No errors logged on the sending side. Might be a downstream email provider queue issue, not our code -- needs investigation before reassigning to infra team.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Go to /forgot-password
2. Submit valid email
3. Time until email arrives (observed 18 min in one case)

title: Checkout allows negative quantity via URL manipulation
description: Manually editing the quantity param in the checkout URL to a negative number (e.g. qty=-5) is accepted by the backend and reduces order total below zero. Security/validation gap -- should be treated as high severity even though not yet seen in the wild.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Add item to cart
2. Go to checkout, note URL params
3. Edit qty param to -5
4. Resubmit
5. Order total goes negative, payment step behaves unpredictably

title: Search autocomplete lags 2-3s on mobile
description: Autocomplete suggestions in search bar take 2-3 seconds to appear on mobile devices (tested iOS Safari, Android Chrome). Desktop is near-instant. Not a backend latency issue per API logs (responses <200ms) -- likely a frontend debounce/render issue on mobile specifically.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open site on mobile
2. Tap search bar
3. Type a query character by character
4. Note delay before suggestions render

title: Duplicate notification bug
description: Same as BUG-1006 -- filed independently by another QA engineer who hadn't seen the existing ticket. Recommend closing this as duplicate once confirmed same root cause.
steps_to_reproduce: See BUG-1006.

title: Admin export ERR_403_FORBIDDEN for sub-admin roles
description: Users with 'sub-admin' role (not full admin) get ERR_403_FORBIDDEN when attempting export, even though the role config in the DB shows export permission = true. Permission check logic may not match the DB schema after last week's roles migration.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Log in as sub-admin test account
2. Go to Users > Export
3. Click export
4. ERR_403_FORBIDDEN despite permission flag being true

title: Payment form accepts expired card without client-side warning
description: Entering an expiry date in the past doesn't trigger a validation error until form submission, at which point it round-trips to the processor and comes back declined. Should fail fast client-side per TC-0209.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Go to checkout payment step
2. Enter card with expiry 01/20 (past date)
3. Submit
4. No client-side warning; waits for processor round-trip

title: Search filter by module doesn't persist on page refresh
description: Applying a module filter (e.g. filter to 'Electronics') and then refreshing the page resets the filter to 'All'. Filter state isn't stored in URL params or session -- lives only in frontend component state.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Search for any term
2. Apply module filter
3. Refresh page (F5)
4. Filter resets to 'All'

title: Login session expires mid-checkout without warning
description: If a user's session token expires while they're on the checkout page (long form-fill time), submission fails with ERR_401_UNAUTH and they LOSE their entered shipping/payment info. No warning before expiry, no autosave.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Log in, add item to cart
2. Start checkout, leave form open ~35 min (session TTL is 30 min)
3. Fill remaining fields
4. Submit -> ERR_401_UNAUTH, form data lost

title: Notification preferences toggle doesn't save
description: Toggling 'Order updates' notification preference off in account settings appears to save (UI shows success toast) but reverts to ON after logout/login. Backend PATCH request returns 200 but doesn't appear to persist.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Go to Account > Notifications
2. Toggle 'Order updates' off
3. See success toast
4. Log out, log back in
5. Setting is back to ON

title: Admin bulk export - resolved, follow-up to BUG-1007
description: Root cause of BUG-1007 confirmed: export job loads entire dataset into memory instead of streaming/paginating. Fix deployed using cursor-based pagination in the export query. Verified with 12000-row export in staging.
steps_to_reproduce: See BUG-1007 for original repro. Fix verified against same steps with 12000 rows.

title: Checkout total miscalculates with multiple discount codes
description: Applying two stackable discount codes results in a total that's off by a few cents compared to manual calculation -- looks like a rounding order issue (percentage discount applied before vs after flat discount).
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Add $50 item to cart
2. Apply code SAVE10 (10% off)
3. Apply code FLAT5 ($5 off)
4. Compare displayed total to manual calc

title: ERR_403_FORBIDDEN on password change for SSO-linked accounts
description: Accounts linked via SSO (Google/Microsoft) shouldn't have a local password-change option at all, but currently show the form and fail with ERR_403_FORBIDDEN on submit instead of hiding the option. Confusing UX, not a security bug per se.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Log in via SSO-linked account
2. Go to Account > Security > Change Password
3. Fill form and submit
4. ERR_403_FORBIDDEN with no explanation shown to user

title: Search relevance ranks exact SKU match below fuzzy matches
description: Searching for an exact SKU code (e.g. "SKU-88213") returns the exact match 4th or 5th in results instead of first, behind fuzzy/partial text matches. Relevance scoring seems to weight text similarity over exact identifier match.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Search for exact SKU 'SKU-88213'
2. Observe ranking position of the exact match vs fuzzy matches

title: Notifications - push token not refreshed after app update
description: After a mobile app update, the device's push token changes but the backend isn't notified, so notifications silently stop working until the user logs out and back in. No error shown to user -- notifications just stop.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Have app installed with notifications working
2. Update app to new version
3. Trigger a notification-worthy event
4. No notification received

title: Admin role edit form silently drops permissions not in current view
description: Editing a user's admin role via the paginated permissions UI and saving will silently REMOVE permissions that exist in the DB but weren't rendered on the currently visible page of the form. Data loss bug, not just cosmetic.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Create role with permissions spanning 2+ pages of the permissions UI
2. Edit role, only view/change page 1
3. Save
4. Check DB -- permissions from page 2 are gone

title: Payment retry after decline charges card twice
description: If a payment is declined and the user clicks 'Retry' quickly, occasionally BOTH the original attempt and the retry go through to the processor, resulting in a double charge. Suspect missing idempotency key on retry request. HIGH severity -- real money impact.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Use a card that gets declined then approved on retry (test processor supports this)
2. Submit payment (declines)
3. Click Retry immediately
4. Check processor dashboard for duplicate charge
